newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up, seen at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up, seen at high levels.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed higher on Thursday amid a shortage of liquidity and are likely to remain at those levels in the absence of any major inflow, dealers said.
"As expected, the market opened on a high note with borrowers bidding at 18 percent and 19 percent and lenders offering at 20 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
With the market short of liquidity, the rates remained at these levels and most of the deals were done at 19.95 percent, he said.
